name: lean-ctx
post_install_message: lean-ctx installed and configured. Shell hooks active (agents-only). RESTART Claude Code so the MCP tools register. Check savings with `lean-ctx gain`.
description: Context Engineering Layer for AI Coding — auto-compresses shell output via hooks (no prefix needed), exposes 69 MCP tools (ctx_read/ctx_search/ctx_shell/…) in 10 read modes, archives large tool results. `lean-ctx onboard` connects to Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, and more.
